description: Decode SCALE-encoded hex into labelled fields with RAO→TAO and hex→SS58 conversions applied. Omit pallet and name to identify an event or call from its two-byte (pallet index, item index) prefix — the usual case when you have bytes and want to know what they are.

hex.description: SCALE-encoded bytes as hex, with or without a 0x prefix. Whitespace is ignored.

kind.description: What the bytes are: 'event' (default), 'call', or 'value' for a bare value of a given type

name.description: Event or call name. Must be given together with "pallet".

pallet.description: Pallet of the event or call. Omit together with "name" to identify the item from the byte prefix instead.

type.description: For kind="value": the SCALE type to decode against, e.g. "u64", "AccountId", "Vec<u16>", "Option<u32>"

name: subtensor_decode
title: Decode SCALE data
